minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / NEXT Beverly Hills Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, July 11, 2024
  6:30 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  July 11, 2024 / 6:30 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Lester Friedman, Councilmember Mary Wells, Deputy City Manager
  Keith Sterling, Director of Community Services Stephanie Harris, NEXT
  Beverly Hills Committee Chair Charles Smith, NEXT Beverly Hills
  Committee Vice Chair Ellen Labbe

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Welcome & Introductions:
  a. Julian Gold: Former Mayor

  3) NEXT Beverly Hills Mission Statement:
  a. NEXT Beverly Hills is a committee of talented next generation leaders focused on
  innovative initiatives which address lifestyle, economic, and civic needs of those in
  their 20s, 30s, and 40s chartered by the mayor and the city of Beverly Hills that
  seeks to engage all that are interested to inspire them and to make Beverly Hills a
  better place for all.

  4) New Business:
  a. There was a recommendation to have staff present on either the city run
  preschools or senior affordable housing at the next NEXT meeting. More people
  supported discussing senior affordable housing.
  b. There was also a request to discuss the parking placard program with PD when
  they come.
  c. Presentation on Next Night:
  i. Next Night will be on Saturday, September 28th from 4 PM to 9 PM.
  ii. The theme for decorations will be neon electric colors and will feature
  colorful lighting gels and neon wearable pieces.
  iii. The Ferris Wheel will be replaced with a carousel.
 Highlights for July 11, 2024
NEXT Beverly Hills Committee

  iv. The CAD is still in development.
  v. Activities are being concentrated in the center of the street which will push
  foot traffic closer to the businesses which will attract people to them.
  vi. The footprint will be at 200 S Beverly from the news stand to Gregory Way.
  vii. The activities at the Children’s area will be being updated to include
  activities for younger children.
  viii. There will be a central dining area.
  ix. There was a multitude of requests from local businesses to remove the
  food trucks and replace them with local restaurants. NEXT is currently
  discussing with each restaurant on the block to prepare grab-&-go options.
  x. NEXT will know in around a month how many businesses will participate
  and if they will need to bring in food trucks.
  xi. There has been some planning to add a sports area for middle school age
  kids if there is enough space.
  xii. All booths will be interactive.
  xiii. The BHUSD PTAs and BHEF will also be participating.
  xiv. Should the sports area go through, it will be done in partnership with the
  city little leagues as well as AYSO.
  xv. Next Night would also like to incorporate a Battle of the Bands for the high
  school age kids around 4PM instead of Madrigals and the Drum line. This
  event would be judged by members of the community and the winner will
  receive a donated prize. This would run from 4-5 PM.
  xvi. NEXT has recruited several business leaders on South Beverly to convince
  their neighbors to participate in the event.
  xvii. A formal request will be made to the businesses in the coming days with a
  deadline. Responding to this request will include what specifically each
  business will do during the event. Should participation from the businesses
  be lackluster, food trucks will be brought in.
  xviii. Participating restaurants will set up a stand on the sidewalk.
  xix. Councilmember Wells brought up the idea of promoting which restaurants
  are participating in the event.
  xx. There will be a DJ for the entire evening.
  xxi. For the music, most people wanted some type of high energy, 80s or 90s
  yacht rock.
  xxii. There has been some problem finding performers that both fit that
  description but also fit the budget.
  xxiii. All plans will be sent to Stephanie and Kieth who will then share it with the
  NEXT chairs.

  4) City Council Liaison Update – Civic Awareness Updates
  a. The City Council reviewed retail queueing for the triangle and it will allow people
  to freely line up outside a store, but a store will need to acquire a permit to place a
  barrier.
  b. The Council has discussed moving landlord-tenant relations to HR from the Rent
  Stabilization Committee.
 Highlights for July 11, 2024
NEXT Beverly Hills Committee

  c. There will be a temporary display of an October 7th memorial, with a permanent
  display coming sometime in the future.
  d. The Council agreed with City staff’s finding that the project at 125-129 S Linden
  filed an incomplete application and so denied the project. The developer filed an
  appeal in court the next day.
  e. The project at 9229 Wilshire was approved due to it meeting all the requirements
  for density bonus under state law.
  f. Beverly Hills Cop Axel F premiered at the Wallace.
  g. City Council hosted several wounded Israeli soldiers at City Hall.
  h. The FY 2024-2025 Budget was approved.
  i. The Council is looking at reevaluating how it sets its priorities.

  5) City Staff Announcements and upcoming events for the Next Generation:
  a. July is the City’s Parks Make Life Better month. Tonight is a concert on Canon
  which will happen every Thursday. There is a yappy hour on July 28th from 10-12
  at the Dog Park.
  b. Picklefest is August.
  c. Festival Beverly Hills will be in Beverly Garden Park from 12 to 6 PM on July 21st.
  d. National Night Out is August 6th outside of Fire Station 1.
  e. El Rodeo will have its ribbon cutting on August 11th at 11 AM.
  f. Team Beverly Hills applications are available online from now through August 9th.
  g. Bastille Day is on the 14th and there will be a free event at Beverly Canon Gardens
  at 3:30 PM.

  6) Future Business:
  a. Pierre wanted to shout out Beverly Hills student Gonzalo Roden who was in the
  filming of the second season of Goosebumps.

  7) Post Meeting Networking Session (Off-Site):

  8) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: July 11, 2024 / 7:35 PM
